name: Transit Police expansion
description: Expand Transit Police to 220 uniformed officers with data-driven deployment.

name: 30 in 30 station deep cleaning
description: Deep clean 30 stations every 30 days.

description: Station upgrade cited as an example.

name: Susquehanna-Dauphin Station upgrade
description: Station upgrade cited as an example.

name: New Route 72 (Cheltenham Avenue)

name: SEPTA GO on-demand zones
program: A New Era of Bus Travel

program: A New Era of Bus Travel
description: Replace tens of thousands of bus stop signs; 10 solar ePaper displays debuted in 2026, location studies for 90 more.

name: Trolley fleet replacement (130 low-floor LRVs)
description: Replace the 40-year-old trolley fleet with 130 accessible low-floor light rail vehicles.

name: Trolley stations and corridors
description: Accessible stations with shelters, seating, real-time info and wayfinding; enhanced tunnel stations; sidewalk and separated bike lane improvements; stop consolidation and signal priority; 5-min peak on T, 15-min peak on D.

name: New L Line subway cars and signal system
description: New Market-Frankford cars arriving from 2029 (open gangways, wider doors) and new signal system; up to 3-minute headways.

name: New B Line vehicles
description: Replace 125 B-IV cars that are 40+ years old.

name: New M Line vehicles
description: Replace the 26-car Norristown High Speed Line fleet in service since 1993.

name: Metro Station Improvement Program
description: Elevators at every Metro station, new headhouses, waterproofing, lighting, communications and safety systems; full accessibility at every Metro station.

name: Silverliner VI Regional Rail fleet
description: Replace the 50-year-old Silverliner IV fleet with Silverliner VI cars, 2030-2035: level boarding, bike storage, 35% faster boarding.

name: Schuylkill-to-Suburban Reconstruction
description: Repair Schuylkill River bridge, rehab bridge over CSX, repair 23rd St Viaduct, replace 22nd and 21st St bridges, rebuild 20th St Interlocking, reconfigure junctions for through-running. 400+ trains, 90,000+ daily riders.
related_fy27_project: Mainline–Schuylkill Bridges and Interlockings (30th Street Station to Suburban Station)

name: Wissahickon Transit Center
description: New shelters, lighting and operator facilities; 7,000 daily riders on 11 routes.

name: South Philadelphia Transit Center
description: Dual-site transit center at Pier 70 and South Front Street connecting 7 routes and consolidating ends-of-line.
location_note: South Front St site location approximate.

description: Camera enforcement of bus/trolley lanes with the PPA on 16 bus routes and T and G trolleys.
